coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up early, showering and personal hygiene (scheduled before Member 4's 07:00 shower and Member 3's 07:20 wash to avoid the shared bathroom clash)
Preparing and eating breakfast and making tea with the kettle and toaster; Member 4 joins from 07:30 to prepare breakfast, so they chat while sharing the kitchen
Setting up the desk and reviewing today's study plan
Studying online for the Master of Education at the desk using the computer and desk lamp, attending remote lectures and reading course materials
Cooking and eating lunch, reheating food with the microwave while Member 2 cooks her own lunch on the induction cooker
Taking a short break, checking the phone and resting on the sofa
Continuing online study and coursework, writing assignments on the computer and reviewing notes
Doing light stretching and indoor exercise together with Member 2, then resting with the fan on
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and rice cooker, sharing the kitchen with Member 3 who is also cooking
Eating dinner together with Member 2 and Member 3
Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen benches together with Member 2 and Member 3
Doing laundry with the washing machine and tidying up
Relaxing, browsing the phone and reading in the bedroom while Member 2 and Member 3 use the Living Room for video calls
Making a hot drink and preparing a light evening snack
Reading course materials and planning the next day's study tasks at the desk
Night routine: washing up and brushing teeth (after Member 2's evening shower and laundry finish at 22:40)
Winding down, dimming the desk lamp and going to sleep
